boundary: Actual verification React components in StrictMode and product CSS with intercepted local HTTP. No real authentication, email, account, verification token, sign-in, provider/model or external effect. Root route selection separately verified with actual DashboardContent and mocked normal app/canvas.
checks: StrictMode mounting only reads current bootstrap status; no email, login or confirmation is sent
Explicit Send posts only the exact current opaque snapshot and never a user-supplied email
Denied refresh clears cached identity, send authority and prior delivery messages
Late status response from identity A cannot populate identity B
StrictMode callback captures a single proof in memory, removes fragment and makes no automatic confirmation or login call
Confirm requires a click; proof is sent only in JSON with no referrer and creates no session or browser storage
390px callback fits both existing light and dark themes
Malformed and extra fragment fields are cleared without reflection or a request
A stalled confirmation settles at the bounded timeout without retaining a retryable proof or automatically resending
No page/console errors, external requests or source drift; all responses are explicit fixtures
